rationale: The agent changed the earbuds color and claimed a lower price with a refund, but violated key policies. It did not properly authenticate the user beyond name and ZIP, and it executed the order modification without first confirming the change with the user. It also stated specific product details, pricing, refund amount, PayPal credit, and a restriction on further modifications without visible supporting tool outputs. These constitute acting without required confirmation and providing potentially unsupported information, so the interaction fails the policy-compliance bar despite fulfilling the basic request.
